development_metric: Exact frozen source roles and required-source-span containment upper bounds; report recovery/regression against unchanged baseline.
reference_policy: Frozen 97 definite opportunities, two unresolved and 47 controls remain unchanged. Development outcomes are not held-out generalization.
semantic_false_positive_policy: Report new geometries, reference-unmatched candidates and known control contacts as review-work proxies. Semantic false-positive count is unknown without source/candidate audit; never interpret unmatched as false.
advancement_policy: Codex reviews material recovery of demonstrated classes, regressions, bounded growth and control burden after Brian runs the comparison. No fixed .80 development gate and no automatic PASS. Then prepare metadata-only fresh selection; confirmation execution is separately held.
